hub.title: Committee Hub
hub.subtitle: Committees and boards, meetings, decision papers, votes, actions and escalations. Every command is checked, computed and recorded by the server.
hub.internalApprovals: Approvals recorded here are internal electronic approvals — not legally certified signatures.

audit.decision_table: Tabled the decision at a meeting
audit.authority_matrix_verify_approval: Verified an authority matrix version's approval (in force)
audit.authority_matrix_reject_approval_evidenc: Rejected the approval evidence of an authority matrix version

committees.title: Committees and boards
committees.distinct: The program committee, the NewCo board and the JV board are separate bodies: a committee decision is never presented as a board resolution.

create.title: Create a committee or board
create.kindHint: The body type cannot be changed later.
create.name: Name
create.effect: The committee is created as a draft. Its charter must be approved (by someone other than the drafter) and the committee activated before meetings can be scheduled.

update.label: Amend charter
update.title: Save a new charter version
update.cadenceIsProposal: Cadence is a proposal (not a confirmed schedule)
update.effect: A new charter version is saved and kept in the history; it needs approval by someone other than its drafter.

approve.label: Approve charter
approve.title: Approve charter version {version}
approve.effect: Approves charter version {version}. You cannot approve a version you drafted.

activate.label: Activate committee
activate.title: Activate the committee
activate.effect: The committee can hold meetings and circulations once active.

add.label: Add seat
add.title: Add a committee seat
add.personHint: Leave empty for a seat whose holder is not yet confirmed; it is shown as "Role — To be confirmed".
add.votingHint: Only the chair, the sponsor and voting members can vote.
add.effect: The seat is added to the committee from the start date.

end.label: End term
end.title: End a seat's term
end.effect: The seat stays in the history. Attendance and votes already recorded are unchanged; the end date cannot precede them.

matrix.title: Delegated authority matrix
matrix.none: No approved authority matrix is in force. Production approval authority is not active: votes and outcomes are refused until one is approved.
matrix.quorumRule: Quorum: at least {min} eligible voting members present, and at least {percent}% of eligible voting members.

approve.label: Approve
approve.title: Approve authority matrix version {version}
approve.effect: Activates this version and supersedes the version in force. A Demo policy can only be approved in a demo project, and you cannot approve a version you drafted.
approve.effectPending: Records your approval of this loaded (non-demo) version with its approval document. It does NOT come into force yet: the version in force stays until the approval is verified.
approve.effectVerifier: A second person — not the drafter, not you, not the uploader of the approval document — must verify the approval document to bring this version into force.
approve.donePending: Approval recorded — awaiting verification by a second person.
approve.demoNoDocument: Demo policy (synthetic): it takes effect on approval in a demo project; there is no approval record to attach.
approve.documentHint: The approved delegation or resolution, uploaded in the Documents center. Its current version is bound to this approval.
approve.documentNone: No documents match. Upload the approval record in the Documents center first.
approve.documentNoVersion: No uploaded version — cannot be used
approve.documentNoAccess: You cannot read project documents, so you cannot select the approval document. Ask someone who can read it to record the approval.

draft.label: Draft new version
draft.title: Draft an authority matrix version
draft.policyHint: Paste the machine-readable policy described in docs/governance/authority-matrix.md. The server validates it; self-approval prohibition and recusal exclusion are fixed platform rules.
draft.invalidJson: The policy is not valid JSON.
draft.effect: The draft has no effect until someone other than you approves it.

matrix.pendingCallout: Version {version} has a recorded approval awaiting verification of its approval document by a second person. Version {current} stays in force until then.
matrix.pendingCalloutNone: Version {version} has a recorded approval awaiting verification of its approval document by a second person. It is not in force until then.

verify.label: Verify approval
verify.labelFor: Verify the approval of matrix version {version}
verify.title: Verify the approval of authority matrix version {version}
verify.accept: Accept — the approval document supports the approval
verify.reject: Reject — the approval evidence is not sufficient
verify.effectAccept: Version {version} comes into force and supersedes the version in force.
verify.effectReject: The recorded approval is cleared (the reason is kept in the history); the draft can be approved again with correct evidence.
verify.sod: Separation of duties: the drafter, the approver and the uploader of the approval document cannot verify it (the server refuses them).
verify.doneAccept: Approval verified — the version is in force.
verify.youDrafted: You drafted this version: another person verifies its approval.
verify.youApproved: You approved this version: another person verifies its approval.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.subtitle: Numbered meetings and resolutions by circulation, with their agendas, attendance, packs and minutes.

create.title: Schedule a meeting
create.committeeHint: Only active committees can hold meetings.
create.effect: The meeting receives the next number of the committee and starts as Planned.

agenda.title: Agenda requests
agenda.subtitle: Requests are screened by the secretariat before they join a numbered agenda.

request.title: Request an agenda item
request.effect: The secretariat screens the request (accept, return or defer) before it is numbered on an agenda.

screen.title: Screen an agenda request
screen.effect: Accepted items receive the next agenda number; a linked decision paper is tabled at that meeting. You cannot screen a request you made.
screen.reasonRequired: A reason is required to return or defer a request.

agenda.agendaEmpty: No items accepted onto this agenda yet.
agenda.pending: Requests for this meeting awaiting screening

publish.label: Publish agenda
publish.title: Publish the agenda of meeting #{number}
publish.effect: Members see the numbered agenda. At least one accepted item is required.

freeze.label: Freeze pack
freeze.title: Freeze the meeting pack
freeze.effect: The agenda, decision papers, open actions and quorum are frozen into an immutable, hashed snapshot. Later changes do not alter it; freezing again creates a new, linked version.

start.label: Open session
start.title: Open the session of meeting #{number}
start.effect: Attendance, conflict declarations and votes can be recorded while the session is open.

close.label: Close session
close.title: Close the session
close.effect: Voting in the meeting ends; outcomes can still be recorded from the votes cast.

cancel.label: Cancel meeting
cancel.title: Cancel meeting #{number}
cancel.effect: The meeting is cancelled. Decisions tabled at it must be tabled again.

quorum.label: Check quorum
quorum.title: Check quorum
quorum.effect: The server computes quorum from the recorded attendance and the approved authority matrix; the result is stored with the meeting.

draftMinutes.label: Draft minutes
draftMinutes.title: Minutes of meeting #{number}
draftMinutes.reasonHint: Required when correcting approved minutes — the approved version stays in the history.
draftMinutes.effect: The minutes are saved as a draft version for approval by someone other than you.

approveMinutes.label: Approve minutes
approveMinutes.title: Approve the minutes of meeting #{number}
approveMinutes.effect: Approved minutes are immutable and attendance is frozen; corrections create a new version. You cannot approve minutes you drafted.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.effect: Attendance can be corrected until the session closes. Only seats active on the meeting date can attend.
attendance.frozen: Attendance is frozen while votes are open on a decision tabled at this meeting (record the outcome, or defer and resume the decision, first).

conflicts.title: Conflict declarations and recusals
conflicts.effect: Declarations are append-only. A recusal excludes the member from voting and from quorum on that decision.
conflicts.onBehalfReason: A recusal recorded on behalf of another member needs a reason. It is refused once the member has voted in the current round.

quorum.title: Quorum
quorum.detail: {present} of {eligible} eligible voting members present (required: {required}) on {date}.

decisions.title: Decisions tabled
decisions.empty: No decisions tabled at this meeting.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.subtitle: Decision papers from draft to verified implementation. Outcomes are computed by the server from quorum, votes and the approved authority matrix.

create.title: Draft a decision paper
create.effect: The paper is saved as a draft with you as the requester. It can be submitted once every required field is complete.

paper.title: Decision paper
paper.decisionTypeHint: From the committee's authority matrix. A type that is not in the approved matrix is treated as outside the committee's authority.
paper.whyNow: Why a decision is needed now
paper.impactsHint: State each impact — write "None identified" rather than leaving one out.
paper.amountInvalid: Enter a positive decimal amount with at most 4 decimal places.
paper.missingTitle: The paper cannot be submitted yet

missing.whyNow: Why a decision is needed now

paper.complete: The paper is complete and can be submitted.

recommended.title: Recommended — pending external authority
recommended.body: The committee supports this decision, but it is outside the committee's delegated authority. This is not an approval: {body} must decide, and dependent gates stay blocked until that decision is recorded with its reference.
recommended.evidence: Recording the authority's decision requires its resolution or record as evidence on this decision, verified by a second person.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.approvalNotImplementation: Approval is not implementation: an approved decision stays open until its implementation is verified with evidence.

votes.title: Votes
votes.immutable: Votes are final and are kept unchanged even when a membership ends or the matrix changes.

recusals.title: Recusals
recusals.rule: A recusal is refused once the member has voted in the current round; the round is then restarted (defer, then resume).
recusals.recordedByOther: another person (not a seat holder of this committee)

actions.title: Implementation actions
actions.empty: No actions linked to this decision yet.

submit.label: Submit
submit.title: Submit {code} for review
submit.effect: The paper is sent to the secretariat. The server refuses an incomplete paper and lists the missing fields.

startReview.label: Start review
startReview.title: Accept {code} for deliberation
startReview.effect: The decision is opened for deliberation and voting. You cannot review a paper you requested.

return.label: Return to draft
return.title: Return {code} to draft
return.effect: The paper goes back to the requester with your reasons. Votes already cast no longer count (a new voting round opens).

vote.label: Vote
vote.title: Vote on {code}
vote.effect: Votes are final. The server checks that you are an active voting member recorded present, that quorum is present, that you are not recused and that you did not request this decision.
vote.requesterHint: You requested this decision: the server refuses your vote (self-approval is prohibited).
vote.recusedHint: You are recused from this decision: the server refuses your vote.
vote.alreadyVoted: You already voted in this round ({choice}).
vote.conflictFirst: If you have a conflict of interest, declare your recusal before voting: once you have voted in this round, a recusal is refused until the round is restarted.

recordOutcome.label: Record outcome
recordOutcome.title: Record the outcome of {code}
recordOutcome.effect1: The server computes quorum, the tally and the authority check from the recorded attendance, the votes and the approved authority matrix.
recordOutcome.effect2: Within the committee's mandate a passing vote becomes Approved; outside it, the decision becomes Recommended — pending external authority, and an escalation is raised.
recordOutcome.integrity: Refused if the round contains votes of recused members, of the requester or of members no longer recorded present: defer and resume the decision to open a new round.

external.label: Record external decision
external.title: Record the external authority's decision on {code}
external.referenceHint: Required. The person who recorded the recommendation cannot record the external decision.
external.effect: Records the decision of {body} with its reference and closes the escalation.
external.evidenceEffect: The verified evidence you select is recorded with the decision.

defer.label: Defer
defer.title: Defer {code}
defer.effect: Consideration is postponed; resuming it opens a new voting round.
defer.newRound: Defer, then resume, is also how a voting round is restarted when a recusal or an attendance correction is needed after votes were cast.

resume.label: Resume
resume.title: Resume {code}
resume.effect: The decision returns to review in a new voting round; votes of earlier rounds stay in the history but no longer count.

circulate.label: Circulate
circulate.title: Resolve {code} by circulation
circulate.effect: A frozen circulation packet is issued. Quorum is counted from the voting members who respond; the same thresholds apply.

recuse.label: Declare recusal
recuse.title: Declare that you are recused from {code}
recuse.effect: You will not vote and will not count toward quorum for this decision. A recusal cannot be withdrawn.
recuse.afterVote: Refused if you already voted in the current round: then the decision has to be deferred and resumed (a new voting round) before the recusal is recorded.

supersede.label: Supersede
supersede.title: Supersede {code}
supersede.byHint: Must be an approved decision of this project.
supersede.effect: The decision becomes read-only and links to the decision that replaces it.

startImplementation.label: Start implementation
startImplementation.title: Start implementation tracking of {code}
startImplementation.effect: Implementation tracking starts. At least one action with an owner and a due date must be linked.

verifyImplementation.label: Verify implementation
verifyImplementation.title: Verify the implementation of {code}
verifyImplementation.effect: Marks the decision Implemented — verified. All linked actions must be verified closed; you cannot be the person who started tracking or an action owner.

recuseOnBehalf.label: Record recusal on behalf
recuseOnBehalf.title: Record a recusal on behalf of a member — {code}
recuseOnBehalf.effect: The member will not vote and will not count toward quorum for this decision. You are recorded as the person who recorded it, with the reason.
recuseOnBehalf.memberHint: Seat holders of the committee who are not yet recused.
recuseOnBehalf.done: Recusal recorded on behalf of the member.

evidence.title: Evidence of this decision
evidence.hint: For a recommendation, link the external authority's resolution or record here; another person verifies it before the external decision is recorded.

actions.title: Actions
actions.subtitle: Committee actions with one accountable owner and a due date. Closure needs evidence and a verifier who is not the owner.

create.title: Create an action
create.ownerHint: One accountable owner, who must be an active member of the project.
create.effect: The owner reports the action done with evidence; a different person verifies its closure.

reportDone.label: Report done
reportDone.title: Report {code} done
reportDone.effect: The action waits for verification by someone other than you.

verify.label: Verify closure
verify.title: Verify the closure of {code}
verify.effect: Closes the action as verified. The owner and the person who reported it done cannot verify it.

reject.label: Return
reject.title: Return {code} to the owner
reject.effect: The closure evidence is not sufficient; the action goes back in progress.

cancel.label: Cancel
cancel.title: Cancel {code}
cancel.effect: A cancelled action never counts as complete.

edit.label: Re-date or reassign
edit.title: Re-date or reassign {code}
edit.effect: The change is versioned and recorded in the history.

escalations.title: Escalations
escalations.subtitle: Each escalation states the requested action, the decision deadline and the options.

raise.title: Raise an escalation
raise.effect: The escalation appears in the committee's list until it is resolved.

resolve.label: Resolve
resolve.title: Resolve {code}
resolve.effect: Closes the escalation. You cannot resolve an escalation you raised.

codes.external_evidence_required: The external authority's decision needs verified evidence on this decision: link the resolution or record as evidence, have a second person verify it, then select it here.
codes.external_evidence_other_target: The selected evidence belongs to another record. Select evidence linked to this decision.
codes.external_evidence_not_active: The selected evidence is no longer active (superseded, conflicting or rejected). Link current evidence and have it verified.
codes.external_evidence_unverified: The selected evidence has not been verified yet. A second person must verify it in the evidence section before the external decision is recorded.
codes.matrix_evidence_required: Approving a loaded (non-demo) authority matrix requires the approval record as a document. Upload it in the Documents center, then select it.
codes.matrix_approval_pending_verification: An approval is already recorded on this version and awaits verification by a second person.
codes.matrix_no_pending_approval: This version has no approval awaiting verification.
codes.matrix_rejection_reason_required: Give a reason to reject the approval evidence.
codes.matrix_evidence_not_visible: You cannot read the approval document, so you cannot verify it. Ask someone who can read it.
codes.matrix_evidence_not_usable: The approval document's version cannot be relied upon (its file check did not pass). Upload a usable version first.
codes.matrix_evidence_deleted: The selected approval document has been disposed of. Select another document.
codes.matrix_evidence_no_version: The selected document has no uploaded version. Upload the file first.
codes.matrix_demo_policy_non_demo_project: A Demo authority policy can only be approved in a demo project. Load the approved delegation matrix instead.
codes.matrix_not_draft: Only a draft matrix version can be approved.
codes.recusal_after_vote: The member already voted in round {round}, so a recusal now would discard a cast vote. Defer the decision, resume it to open a new voting round, then record the recusal before the member votes.
codes.recusal_after_vote_noRound: The member already voted in the current round, so a recusal now would discard a cast vote. Defer the decision, resume it to open a new voting round, then record the recusal before the member votes.
codes.recusal_reason_required: A recusal recorded on behalf of another member needs a reason.
codes.recusal_not_member: Recusals are recorded only for members of the decision's committee.
codes.recusal_decision_closed: Recusals can no longer be recorded: the decision is closed.
codes.recusal_duplicate: This member is already recused from the decision.
codes.attendance_frozen_voting_open: Attendance is frozen while voting is open on {decisions}. Record the outcome first, or defer the decision and resume it to open a new voting round, then correct attendance.
codes.attendance_frozen_voting_open_noList: Attendance is frozen while voting is open on a decision tabled at this meeting. Record the outcome first, or defer the decision and resume it to open a new voting round, then correct attendance.
codes.outcome_vote_integrity: The outcome cannot be recorded: round {round} contains votes cast by members who are recused, requested the decision or are no longer recorded present (votes concerned: {count}). Cast votes are never discarded — defer the decision and resume it to open a new voting round.
codes.outcome_vote_integrity_noCounts: The outcome cannot be recorded: the current round contains votes cast by members who are recused, requested the decision or are no longer recorded present. Cast votes are never discarded — defer the decision and resume it to open a new voting round.

evidence.legend: Evidence of the external authority's decision
evidence.hint: Only active evidence on this decision that a second person verified can be used. Whoever verified it cannot also record the decision.
evidence.noAccess: You cannot read the evidence of this decision, so you cannot select it. Ask someone who can read the documents to record the external decision.
evidence.noneTitle: No verified evidence on this decision yet.
evidence.step1: Link the resolution or record of the external authority as evidence in the Evidence section of this decision.
evidence.step2: Ask another person (secretariat, legal or finance) to verify it.
evidence.step3: Come back here and select the verified evidence.
evidence.awaiting: Evidence awaiting verification by a second person: {count}.
evidence.goToEvidence: Go to the evidence of this decision
evidence.verifiedByYou: You verified this evidence: another person must record the external decision.
